The first half was a cagey affair with limited clear-cut chances, leading to a goalless draw at the break. As the second half got underway, Leicester made proactive changes, bringing on Taylor Gardner-Hickman and Todd Cantwell . The intensity rose quickly after the restart, leading to yellow cards for Ricardo Pereira and Sean McLoughlin as both teams fought for dominance in the middle of the park. After a series of substitutions, including the introduction of Jordan Ayew , Leicester found their clinical edge. Stephy Mavididi capitalized on a scoring opportunity to put the English side ahead.
